question: Should `policy watch --interval-ms` intentionally stop accepting plus-prefixed and zero-padded spellings that currently normalize to the same millisecond value?
rationale: The documentation does not define canonical textual spelling, while the current parser explicitly accepts these forms, so code review cannot safely infer whether rejection is desired product policy.

options.title: Preserve equivalent spellings
options.body: Remove the canonical-string equality gate and retain current behavior for values that represent the same safe interval.

options.title: Approve canonical decimal only
options.body: Keep the rejection, document the stricter CLI contract, and require supported-Node before/after/control terminal proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve equivalent spellings
recommendation.body: Remove the canonical-string equality gate and retain current behavior for values that represent the same safe interval.
